levels.description:
Attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_s2:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage, and snow spreads to surrounding tiles after reaching 5 stacks (Spreads to a max of 20 tiles); ground enemies on snow tiles take <@ba.vup>{talent@s2_magic_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage every second, and are inflicted with <@ba.vup>5</> seconds of <$ba.cold>Cold</> after leaving a snow tile; When snow accumulates on the Objective Point 5 times, it freezes
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration, can manually deactivate skill (skill can be deactivated at will)</>
